summary.text: Jill Barry is a state representative from Connecticut who has represented House District 31 since 2019 and is seeking re-election on the Republican and Independent Party of Connecticut lines in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Barry lives in Glastonbury, Connecticut, as of September 2019, and was recognized by the Connecticut Association of Schools with two awards for her volunteerism in 2014 and 2017.
Barry first won the District 31 seat in the 2018 general election, defeating Lillian Tanski, and was re-elected in 2020, 2022 and 2024.
In 2020 she defeated Stewart Beckett and in 2022 she defeated Gary Giannelli; in 2024 she was unopposed in the general election.
In the 2026 general election she faces Moise Carelus, a Democrat who also appears on the Working Families Party line.

For the 2025-2026 session she was assigned to the Finance, Revenue and Bonding Committee, the Public Safety and Security Committee, and the Insurance and Real Estate Committee, where she is vice-chair.
